About the dialogue

Conversations that usually go unspoken.

Come to learn. Come to listen. Come to speak.

Chattogram, PsychTalks and Volunteers for Bangladesh bring you an open dialogue on Gen-Z, mental health, personal growth, and youth-led action — built around real conversation, not formal lecture.

Most importantly, come be part of the community that's rebuilding how young people talk about their minds.

HOST

PsychTalks

Mental health education for young people — grounded in theory, delivered with care.

CO-HOSTED WITH

Volunteers for Bangladesh

Youth Wing of JAAGO Foundation — mobilising young people to rebuild their communities.

What to expect

An afternoon built around five things.

Every part of the room is designed to make the conversation easier to have.

Learning Session

Beyond Surviving: A Youth's Guide to Mental Well-being

Personal growth, emotional well-being, and navigating young adulthood.

Panel Discussion

Youth in Action: Advocacy for Mental Health

Youth advocacy, community well-being, and volunteering.

On-site

Mental Health Assessment Booth

A quiet, private space to check in with yourself.

Included

Refreshments

Tea, snacks, and time to talk between sessions.

Included

Certificate of Participation

Given to every registered attendee.

Duration

2 hours, one room

4:00 PM – 6:00 PM. No lecture format — real dialogue throughout.

Session resource person

Leading the learning session.

Mithila Farjana Haque
